name: Jenra Cubing Summer 2026
information:
Jenra Cubing Summer 2026 is an exciting summer speedcubing competition brought to you by Jenra Malls, bringing together cube enthusiasts of all skill levels for a day of fast turns and friendly competition. Featuring official events in 2x2, 3x3, 6x6, 7x7, Skewb, and Pyraminx, this competition is perfect for both newcomers and seasoned competitors looking to set new personal bests.

Join us for an action-packed summer showdown filled with speed, strategy, and community spirit!
